briefdescription.para: Construct an ObjectHandle of the specified class with the specified constructor.

detaileddescription.para:
The following steps are to be performed:
Invoke the auto-generated initializer for the "inception" type;
Invoke the specified constructor, potentially calling some super constructors passing "this:struct" as a target
Invoke all finalizers in the inheritance chain starting at the base passing "this:private" as a target

parameterdescription.para: the register id to place the created handle into

briefdescription.para: Compare for identity equality two object handles that both associated with this template.

detaileddescription.para: As documented at Ref.x equals() function: <quote> Specifically, two references are equal if they reference the same runtime object. Additionally, for optimization purposes, the runtime is *permitted* to indicate that two references to two separate runtime objects are equal, in the case where both references are to immutable objects whose structures are identical. </quote>
Note: this method is inherently native; it must be answered without calling any natural code

simplesect.para: true iff the identities are equal
